subject: [PATCH] memcg: clear FLUSHING_CACHED_CHARGE on cpu offline

reviews.author: Rik van Riel
reviews.summary: Confirmed the solution is correct and thorough, with a safety analysis performed by an AI. Provided a Reviewed-by tag.

2026-08-28.patch_summary: This patch addresses a bug where the FLUSHING_CACHED_CHARGE flag is not cleared when a CPU goes offline, leading to stock draining issues. The fix involves clearing both stocks after draining them in the memcg_hotplug_cpu_dead() function.
